summary.description: DEHP is a pale yellow oily liquid with a slight odour. It belongs to the phthalate group of chemicals and does not evaporate easily.
emission_sources: Leaching or evaporation from consumer products containing DEHP
Release from disposed products in landfills
environmental_impact: Acts as an endocrine disruptor, posing long-term threats to wildlife

top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: DEHP is widely used in consumer products and can leach from them during use and disposal, indicating a need for safer product design and better end-of-life management.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: As an endocrine disruptor, DEHP poses potential long-term health risks, even though background exposure is currently not deemed harmful, highlighting the need for preventive action.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG15_Life_on_Land: DEHP bioaccumulates and affects the endocrine systems of wildlife, potentially disrupting reproductive and developmental processes in terrestrial ecosystems.
